scope: Read-only audit of LW trace-gas coverage in the current option-37 adapter. No isolated flux/OLR/heating residual was computed in this audit.

current_adapter.legacy_call_passes_them: WRF/phys/module_ra_rrtmg_lw.F:13059-13062 (legacy RRTMG call argument list); RRTMGP call at 13046-13055 has only six gases

coefficient_support.interpretation: The pinned files contain supported minor-gas coefficients for all four in LW. In SW their names occur in metadata but none of the minor intervals or key-species slots use them, so passing these VMRs is expected to affect LW only.

omission_mechanism.behavior: reduce_minor_arrays filters minor terms by whether their gas is present in available_gases. Since current available gases are only the six adapter names, the CFC/CCl4 minor intervals are removed at coefficient initialization, not merely given zero VMR at call time.

legacy_vmr_source.dynamic_when_GHG_INPUT_1: read_CAMgases supplies CO2/N2O/CH4/CFC11/CFC12 using the host CAM trace-gas file; the same four radiative VMR fields are populated per layer at 12355-12358.
legacy_vmr_source.note: These are existing WRF fallback constants, not values assumed for every run. cfc22 and ccl4 are set as static wrapper constants in the inspected source even on the GHG_INPUT=1 path.

quantification_status.why: The current RRTMGP adapter API and replay record do not carry the four missing VMR arrays. Existing total RRTMG4-vs-RRTMGP37 differences combine gas, spectral discretization, cloud optics, solar partition, and solver changes, so they cannot be attributed to CFC omission.
quantification_status.structural_quantification: 4 supported LW minor absorbers are omitted; their coefficients occupy LW bands 5, 6 and 8; no corresponding SW intervals were found.

proposed_isolated_experiment: Use one saved WRF raw column with matching play/plev/tlay/tlev/tsfc, six common gas VMRs, surface emissivity, cloud paths/fractions, and seed. Preserve the source run’s exact cfc11/12 CAM-interpolated VMRs plus cfc22/ccl4 wrapper constants; do not substitute arbitrary climatology.

Build two scratch RRTMGP runs with identical pinned code/data and all inputs: A current six-gas behavior (four trace VMRs absent/zero); B provide cfc11/cfc12/cfc22/ccl4. Compare gas tau by g-point, LW upward/downward flux at surface and TOA, and heating-rate profile. Use clear-sky first to avoid cloud-mask sampling; repeat actual cloud state with fixed mask/seed if required.

Only after the within-RRTMGP A/B effect is measured, report RRTMG4-vs-RRTMGP37 with the same trace-gas VMRs as a separate composite engine comparison. A passing A/B checks wiring; it does not establish equal full-system physics.
